facts.claim: The teaching of the native languages, Hindustani at Mercara, and Canarese in the districts, consisted in reading and writing of the alphabets, getting by heart of multiplication tables and, when the scholars had further advanced, the reading and writing of petitions (Arjis).

facts.claim: In 1855, encouraged by Sir MarkCubbon, Dr. Moegling, the first Protestant Missionary in Coorg, established an English School at Mercara, the charge of which was placed into the hands of the Eev. G. Richter in May 1856 and in February 1857 the Supreme Government sanctioned a liberal grant for its support.

facts.claim: The Head-sheristadar, Nanchappa, having been reconciled to the new order of things, the School began to flourish and gain the favour of the people.
